Jon Venables and Robert Thompson were ten-years-old when they abducted two-year-old James Bulger from a shopping area in Northern England in 1993. The two boys walked around with the toddler for hours before finally beating him to death and leaving him on the railroad tracks, his head covered with bricks. Thompson and Venables, were released to freedom when they were 18, after having served eight years in a juvenile facility.
